title: Hemoglobin

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: Hemoglobin is an iron-rich protein in your red blood cells that carries oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body. This test measures the level of hemoglobin in the blood.
context: The normal range can vary based on the laboratory and on age, race, and sex. Diet, activity level, certain medicines, dehydration, smoking, living at a higher altitude, and some genetic conditions can also affect the result, and one result alone cannot tell what is causing it.
aboveRange: Living at a higher altitude, dehydration, or smoking
Can be associated with lung conditions or heart conditions
Can be associated with polycythemia vera, in which the bone marrow makes too many red blood cells
Can be associated with sleep apnea
belowRange: Can be associated with different types of anemia or thalassemia
Can be associated with iron deficiency or a lack of certain nutrients such as vitamin B-12
Blood loss from injury, a heavy menstrual period, or other causes
Can be associated with liver conditions, cancer, and other conditions
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
